name: Competition Hall
info: Main sports hall, entrance B. Indoor shoes required. Spotters get a short safety briefing at the start of each shift.

name: Warm-up Hall
info: Small hall next to the changing rooms. Only athletes with a start number and their coaches inside.

name: Judges' Table
info: On the gallery of the competition hall. Laptops and score sheets are provided.

name: Registration
info: Foyer at the main entrance. Volunteers check in here too: pick up your T-shirt before your first shift.

name: Cafeteria
info: Foyer, next to Registration. Cake donations are welcome, please bring them before 9:00.
